description: Abstract class for fetching and processing attributes and telemetry data within the Thingsboard rule engine, including asynchronous data retrieval, message transformation, and failure handling.

classes.name: TbAbstractGetAttributesNode
classes.description: Abstract class for handling attribute and telemetry retrieval in the rule engine, supporting asynchronous operations and message transformation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with context and configuration, setting flags for latest value retrieval and failure reporting.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, initiating entity ID lookup and attribute fetching.

methods.name: findEntityIdAsync
methods.description: Abstract method to asynchronously find the entity ID based on the message.

methods.name: upgradeRuleNodesWithOldPropertyToUseFetchTo
methods.description: Upgrades old configuration nodes to use the current fetch target property.

methods.name: safePutAttributes
methods.description: Fetches attributes and telemetry asynchronously, enriches the message, and handles success or failure.

methods.name: getAttrAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves attribute entries for a given entity, scope, and keys.

methods.name: getLatestTelemetry
methods.description: Retrieves latest telemetry data for specified keys and processes missing data.

methods.name: getValueWithTs
methods.description: Wraps telemetry value with timestamp into a JSON node.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns prefix string based on attribute scope.

methods.name: getNonExistentKeys
methods.description: Determines which requested keys are missing from existing attribute entries.

methods.name: reportFailures
methods.description: Generates an exception message listing missing attribute or telemetry keys.
